pyq_bad.why: wrong topic: Shyama Prasad Mukherji Rurban Mission (rural development)
wrong topic: Union Budget sports allocation

patterns: APPSC asks direct one-liners: definition/ultimate goal of sustainable agriculture, which body is the single platform for rainfed areas (NRAA).
Scheme funding-ratio questions recur (60:40 Centre:State), plus launch-year items (RADP 2011-12, NMSA).
Post-1991 liberalisation effect statements (decline in public investment) appear as statement questions.
App MCQs lean on multi-statement UPSC-style items and 2025-26 AP scheme figures; PYQs are shorter and more definitional.
